description: Retrieval evaluation set for the GypsyCircle knowledge base. Each answerable question lists evidence: every item must be found in the retrieved context (an item with several alternatives is satisfied by any one of them). Evidence strings are verbatim, case-insensitive substrings of the documents, so the set works for any chunking strategy.

questions.question: What fields should be recorded for each lead in the CRM?
When is a booking considered confirmed?
evidence: A booking is confirmed only after the required payment is verified

questions.question: Is a payment screenshot enough proof that the money has arrived?
evidence: A screenshot alone should not be treated as proof of cleared funds

questions.question: What are the stages a sales lead moves through?
Who can pause or change an activity during a trip for safety reasons?
evidence: The trip leader may pause or change an activity

questions.question: What should be checked on the day of departure?
evidence: Verify the vehicle, driver details and pickup point

questions.question: What information should we capture when a new travel enquiry comes in?
evidence: Preferred travel month or departure date

questions.question: Which situations must customer support escalate immediately?
evidence: Immediately escalate safety incidents, medical emergencies, missing travellers

questions.question: Can support staff promise customers a fixed response time?
evidence: staff must not promise a fixed response time

questions.question: What tone should GypsyCircle's marketing communication use?
What must every package promotion post verify before it goes live?
What needs management approval before it is published?
evidence: Management should approve package prices, discount campaigns

questions.question: What should be agreed in writing before confirming a supplier booking?
evidence: Before confirming a service, obtain written agreement on

questions.question: How should suppliers be evaluated?
evidence: Do not select solely on the lowest price

questions.question: Does the vendor procedure set payment limits or credit terms?
evidence: This document does not set payment limits or credit terms

evidence: Trip leaders: group briefing, attendance, safety communication

evidence: Record the trainer, training date, topics completed

questions.question: What should be reviewed at the start of each working day?
What goes into the end-of-day handover?

evidence: If a document conflicts with a newer approved policy

evidence: Team member sends the requested dates and reason to the reporting manager

questions.question: Who are GypsyCircle's target customers?
evidence: particularly for college students and working professionals

questions.question: What are the company's operating principles?
evidence: Do not promise services that suppliers have not confirmed

questions.question: Am I allowed to paste customer details into ChatGPT?
evidence: Do not upload confidential data to public AI tools

questions.question: Can I offer an unhappy customer a free room upgrade on my own?
evidence: Do not make unauthorized commitments on pricing, refunds, upgrades or compensation

evidence: Obtain permission before using customer images
Collect approved trip photos or testimonials only with appropriate consent

evidence: Do not select solely on the lowest price

questions.question: Can I tell customers the trek will definitely happen whatever the weather?
evidence: Never promise that a route or activity will operate regardless of conditions
Do not claim a trip is guaranteed where weather, permits or suppliers can affect operations

What is the gc_pax field for?

evidence: annual, casual, sick and other leave entitlements

evidence: Destination guides and practical travel information

questions.question: How should customer complaints be handled by support, and what should trip staff record about complaints during and after a trip?
evidence: Listen without interrupting or blaming the customer
Record supplier failures and customer complaints

Do not request sensitive identity or payment information
Keep attendance and leave records access-controlled

After each trip, record punctuality, service quality

evidence: Do not use fake testimonials, fabricated discounts or false scarcity

evidence: Report accidents, illness, missing-person concerns or unsafe conditions immediately
Immediately escalate safety incidents, medical emergencies

Payments should follow the company's authorized approval process

evidence: Obtain permission before using customer images
Collect approved trip photos or testimonials only with appropriate consent
